_readme: Engine behaviour. These are Gamify design choices, not client details, so they carry working values.

picker._note: auto shows the language picker when two or more languages are included and skips it for one. always and never force it.

answer._note: autoAdvanceMs 0 means the player taps Next after reading the feedback.

_testViewportsNote: Test viewports for review and QA only. They are not the client's placement sizes, which live in config/client.json placement.sizes and are empty until the specs arrive.
